purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Bomet Central Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF, cropped around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation at 500 DPI. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (BOMET CENTRAL, code 197) was read from the visible 'CON 197' banner marker and the page's own 'Constituency: BOMET CENTRAL / Code: 197' header block before this row was accepted. This independently reproduces (rather than relies upon) the Bomet Central arithmetic-mismatch finding previously narrated in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json's tranche-A note.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: The printed Registered Voters figure (71,409) matches the governed P23 ward-summed registered-voters denominator (KDA-VOTERS-CON-197-2022) exactly, and Rejected Ballots (329) is individually clear. However, the row's own four candidate cells (2,024 + 55,486 + 55 + 105 = 57,670) do not sum to the printed Total Valid Votes (57,565), a 105-vote discrepancy coincidentally equal to the fourth candidate's (Wajackoyah) own printed cell value. Independently re-read at 500 DPI with identical results. This independently reproduces the Bomet Central finding already narrated (from an earlier tranche) in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json. Per the extraction contract's invariant that arithmetic-mismatch rows remain promotion-blocked even when their component integers are individually source-verified, this row is preserved unresolved.
